propositions: A new read-only command `rebar bridge suggest-mapping <PROJECT>` queries live Jira via pycontribs to discover real vocabulary and seed axis maps for the mapping config
The probe grounds axes using only high-level public JIRA methods (issue_types, priorities, statuses, issue_link_types, transitions) and the createmeta API; no private REST endpoints

Default invocation emits suggested [tool.rebar.mapping] block to stdout as TOML without writing files; --write flag performs deep-merge into existing rebar.toml preserving hand edits and flat [jira]/[tracker] siblings
Status vocabulary uses the global Jira status set rather than per-project; transition hints are flagged best-effort since only current-state transitions are visible per sampled issue
An orchestrator (_emit_config_toml) splits reserved mapping table from flat siblings, emitting each through appropriate serialization path to avoid nested-table failures in existing _emit_toml
create_defaults stubs are emitted only for required createmeta fields absent from the baseline create path (summary, description, issuetype, priority, assignee, conditional status/parent)
